project_name: Character model sheet, 4 turnaround views showing front, back, three-quarters, and side profile in one image of Dante Vance, 29-year-old cyberpunk GT3 team leader and racer. Sharp chiseled angular jawline, slicked-back dark undercut with deep purple faded sides, glowing violet cybernetic optic eye with digital reticle on right eye, calculating calm smirk. Wearing high-collar matte void-black techwear racing suit with glowing ultraviolet circuit seams, magnetic harness clips, and black armored racing boots. Holding a matte black GT3 racing helmet with glowing violet polarized visor and HUD telemetry graphics. Crisp cel-shaded anime style, thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, sharp geometric shadows, neutral grey studio background
